items.t: Ignition coil failures
items.job: Replace failed ignition coil(s)
items.note: Low is one aftermarket coil; high is a genuine VW set of four. YourMechanic: about $494 for a 2000-2002 1.8T, with average labor near $140. Many owners replace all four at once because they tend to fail one after another.

items.t: Cam follower wear on the 2.0T FSI
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump cam follower
items.note: Price covers the follower only. If it has worn through and damaged the camshaft lobe, the camshaft (and often the fuel pump) must also be replaced, which costs much more. Forum owners report about 1 hour book time and about $140 total at an independent shop.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioner with the updated part
items.note: Low is the aftermarket updated tensioner (06K109467K) alone; high is a full service kit with gaskets and seals. A VW specialist estimates roughly 5 hours labor. If the chain has already jumped and bent valves, the repair runs about $2,000-$4,000 more.

items.t: Diesel emissions settlement modification
items.job: Approved emissions modification under the diesel settlement
items.note: The approved modification is done free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN with VW or a dealer.
